sources.title: Anthropic Fermat Lean GitHub repo (statement, axioms, triple-check)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: The repo declares fermat_last_theorem for n>=3 over positive naturals, and FinalCheck requires exactly Lean's 3 standard axioms with no sorry, deriving Mathlib's own FermatLastTheorem from it.
claims.context: Front-page statement and FinalCheck gate as stated.

claims.text: Verification as stated: from-scratch lake build on Lean 4.33.1 with Mathlib v4.33.0 checked all 60,475 repo modules in the Lean kernel; comparator v4.33.0 returned Your solution is okay; independent nanoda 0.4.13 Rust kernel accepted 1,052,234 declarations with no errors.
claims.context: Triple-check account as stated; build was not rerun by this record.

claims.text: Hygiene and packaging as stated: no axiom/sorry/native_decide/unsafe/extern/implemented_by/partial/#eval; ~390MB offline html with 29,511 theorems and 1,450 definition modules; Apache 2.0 research artifact, not maintained, crediting Imperial FLT, flt-regular, and Mathlib.

Self-check requirements as stated: Linux/macOS, elan for Lean 4.33.1, network Mathlib fetch/compile, ~5GB per job (some modules 36GB), ~67GB disk plus deletable C files (~220GB), ~5h32m at 96 jobs, comparator ~14h46m.
claims.context: Reproduction-cost facts as stated by the publisher.
